extractorCode:
from pathlib import Path
import sys, json, hashlib, re
from pdfminer.high_level import extract_pages
from pdfminer.layout import LTTextLine, LTContainer, LAParams
import pdfminer

SPECS = [
    ('midway-2023', 'village-of-midway', '/tmp/continuation-municipal/village-of-midway-04bb08ea2b2fc4.pdf', 9, [('elected-officials', 530, 604, 5), ('employee-remuneration', 430, 485, 4)]),
    ('midway-2024', 'village-of-midway', '/tmp/continuation-municipal/village-of-midway-04bb08ea2b2fc4.pdf', 11, [('elected-officials', 530, 604, 5), ('employee-remuneration', 430, 485, 4)]),
    ('sooke-2025', 'district-of-sooke', '/tmp/continuation-municipal/district-of-sooke-f7c218a6018043.pdf', 37, [('elected-officials', 570, 665, 7), ('employee-remuneration', 20, 500, 37)]),
    ('sooke-2025', 'district-of-sooke', '/tmp/continuation-municipal/district-of-sooke-f7c218a6018043.pdf', 38, [('employee-remuneration', 525, 760, 18)]),
]

def walk(obj):
    if isinstance(obj, LTTextLine):
        yield obj
    elif isinstance(obj, LTContainer):
        for child in obj:
            yield from walk(child)

def numeric(text):
    text = text.replace('$', '').strip()
    if text == '-' or text == '':
        return None
    assert re.fullmatch(r'-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?', text), text
    return int(text.replace(',', ''))

pages, cohorts = [], {}
for key, slug, pdf, pg, scopes in SPECS:
    layout = next(extract_pages(pdf, page_numbers=[pg-1], laparams=LAParams(char_margin=2, line_margin=0.3, word_margin=0.1, boxes_flow=None)))
    lines = [{'bbox': list(line.bbox), 'text': line.get_text().strip()} for line in sorted(walk(layout), key=lambda line: (-line.y0, line.x0)) if line.get_text().strip()]
    page = {'key': key, 'originalPdf': pdf, 'originalSha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(pdf).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'physicalPdfPage': pg, 'pageSize': [layout.width, layout.height], 'pdfminerLines': lines}
    pages.append(page)
    is_midway = key.startswith('midway')
    for category, bottom, top, expected_count in scopes:
        anchors = [line for line in lines if 50 < line['bbox'][0] < 90 and line['bbox'][2] < (200 if is_midway else 160) and bottom < line['bbox'][1] < top and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z '\-]*, [A-Za-z][A-Za-z '\-]*", line['text'])]
        assert len(anchors) == expected_count, (key, pg, category, len(anchors))
        cohort_key = key + '-' + category
        cohort = cohorts.setdefault(cohort_key, {'key': cohort_key, 'rows': [], 'rowEvidence': []})
        for i, anchor in enumerate(anchors):
            # Wrapped positions precede the bottom-aligned name. The band runs
            # from this baseline - 2pt up to the preceding name baseline - 2pt.
            # This also captures Mills's elevated 33 expense; footer 34 is below.
            lo = anchor['bbox'][1] - 2
            hi = anchors[i-1]['bbox'][1] - 2 if i else top
            band = [line for line in lines if lo <= line['bbox'][1] < hi]
            pos_lo, pos_hi = (240, 420) if is_midway else (165, 375)
            pay_lo, pay_hi = (440, 497) if is_midway else (400, 475)
            expense_lo, expense_hi = (510, 570) if is_midway else (510, 560)
            positions = [line for line in band if pos_lo < line['bbox'][0] < pos_hi]
            salaries = [line for line in band if pay_lo < line['bbox'][0] < pay_hi and re.fullmatch(r'\d[\d,]*', line['text'])]
            expenses = [line for line in band if expense_lo < line['bbox'][0] < expense_hi and re.fullmatch(r'-|\d[\d,]*', line['text'])]
            assert len(salaries) == 1 and len(expenses) <= 1 and positions, (anchor, positions, salaries, expenses)
            title = ' '.join(line['text'] for line in positions)
            expense_token = expenses[0]['text'] if expenses else ''
            row = [slug, anchor['text'], title, numeric(salaries[0]['text']), numeric(expense_token), pg]
            cohort['rows'].append(row)
            cohort['rowEvidence'].append({'row': row, 'nameAnchor': anchor, 'bandY': [lo, hi], 'positionFragments': positions, 'payCell': salaries[0], 'expenseCells': expenses, 'literalExpenseToken': expense_token})

assert sum(len(c['rows']) for c in cohorts.values()) == 80
out = Path(sys.argv[1])
assert not out.exists(), out
receipt = {'reviewer': '/root/recovery_review', 'reviewedOn': '2026-11-01', 'method': 'Third-engine native PDFMiner extraction independently implemented from original PDFs. Author parser/code/provenance not read or imported. Name anchors derived from left-column comma-name syntax and bounded table scope. Wrapped position fragments and non-baseline expenses grouped within preceding-name-to-current-name bands. This artifact written before reading corresponding normalized candidate payloads.', 'pdfminerVersion': pdfminer.__version__, 'extractorCode': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'candidatePayloadsOpenedBeforeThisArtifact': False, 'rowsExtracted': 80, 'pages': pages, 'cohorts': list(cohorts.values())}
out.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(out)
print(hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
for c in cohorts.values():
    print(c['key'], len(c['rows']), sum(row[3] for row in c['rows']), sum(row[4] or 0 for row in c['rows']))
